directionReset: User explicitly retires pixel, previous mascot, and previous aesthetic requirements. Explore four fresh futuristic directions with light beams, space, realism, fine sharp lines.
retainedInteraction: Companion activates input; conversation accumulates upwards above it. No encompassing chat window.

candidates.name: ORBIT
candidates.detail: Concept label "F01 / ORBIT". Realistic miniature RINGED PLANET companion, warm ivory cloud bands, amber-lit terminator, delicate thin Saturn-like elliptical ring tilted diagonally, shadow side dark but visible. Highly realistic planetary lighting, recognizable full ellipse silhouette, no face or limbs. A faint warm light shaft from ring edge visually guides toward input without touching text. Interface is warm graphite smoked-glass thin rectangles with tiny near-square 3px corners, champagne-gold hairline borders only on bottom/right, warm white text. Messages independent translucent dark slips, assistant reply has slightly lighter pearl-tinted surface. Input a refined horizontal graphite capsule with almost square ends and a very thin light rim. Small champagne send arrow. Overall warm astronomical elegance, restrained gold, no cyan, no dense stars. Companion sits left of input in each state.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / futuristic desktop companion concept. BRAND NEW visual direction, NO reference images. Create a sophisticated photorealistic futuristic desktop companion and its chat overlay, landscape 1536x1024. Original product OmarchyPet. Each concept must have a completely different companion silhouette, materials, illumination and interface design. NO PIXEL ART, no retro terminal mascot, no cartoons, no >_ face, no game HUD clutter, no rounded generic SaaS cards, no toy robot. Product logic is fixed: a small companion next to ONE compact floating text input; typing creates independent message surfaces ABOVE that input, older messages move upwards; no outer chat window, title bar, sidebar, toolbar, model selector or suggestion buttons. Show TWO small states side by side on the same sheet: left third labeled "İlk açılış" with companion + input ONLY, right two-thirds labeled "Konuşurken" with same companion and input plus three independent messages above. Dark nearly black studio desktop backdrop, plenty of negative space, NOT a galaxy wallpaper or movie scene. Companion ~80–110px wide relative to 1536 canvas, input ~430px wide and 52px high; restrained accurate desktop UI scale. Photoreal material/light treatment for companion with premium industrial concept quality. UI must be razor-sharp, very thin precise outlines, clean small modern sans-serif typography, excellent legibility. Light effects stay subtle and localized so text is never obscured. Exact sample UI text: input "Bir şey yaz...", messages top to bottom "GitHub’ı aç.", "GitHub açıldı.", "Bir de Spotify’ı aç.". User messages align right, assistant left, floating with clear negative gaps, and a small simple send arrow at input right. Two state labels and small concept label top-left as specified are the only extra text. Show no fake telemetry, no charts, no decorative icons. Design should look usable and polished rather than overloaded sci-fi fantasy. All UI rests in lower half of composition. Do not include multiple variant characters on one sheet; same companion repeated only for two states.

candidates.name: PRISM
candidates.detail: Concept label "F02 / PRISM". Companion is a slender floating asymmetric triangular OPTICAL CRYSTAL prism, tall faceted wedge, very transparent clear glass with physically realistic refraction and cool cyan/violet spectral edge separation. No sphere or planet. A very thin diagonal white light beam passes through prism and exits as two subtle separated spectral rays, localized to companion only. UI surfaces are near-transparent black glass, dramatically sharp triangular clipped corners, single ultra-thin icy blue contour at alternating edges; message shapes slender angular polygons rather than rounded bubbles. Crisp cool white sans text. Tiny triangular send control, no boxed button. Assistant message slightly luminous frost glass; other messages almost black. Precise architecture and optical instrument feeling, high-end futuristic minimalism. Companion to LEFT of input, taller narrow silhouette. No gold or planets.

candidates.name: MERCURY
candidates.detail: Concept label "F03 / MERCURY". Companion is a floating asymmetrical LIQUID CHROME droplet, not a ball: teardrop crescent body with a hollow notch and one tiny separate satellite droplet suspended near the tip. Reflective polished mercury metal with realistic soft studio reflections and a narrow cold white highlight, one deep burgundy reflection adding subtle color. No facial features, no planet, no wings, no faceted prism. Interface uses soft organic precision: independent slim fluid smoked-silver capsules, gently tapering ends, hairline platinum edges, deep charcoal fill, clean white text. Assistant reply pale brushed-silver translucent capsule with charcoal text; user messages dark metallic glass. Input charcoal with two tiny luminous white endcaps and an understated arrow. Rich but controlled material contrast, almost monochromatic with subdued wine-purple accents. No neon cyan, no orange. Companion LEFT of input, low flowing silhouette.

candidates.name: RELAY
candidates.detail: Concept label "F04 / RELAY". Companion is a realistic tiny ORBITAL PROBE, a matte white ceramic asymmetrical central hexagonal instrument, slim black carbon-fiber articulated crescent arm around one side and a single small RED scanning optical lens. A short white antenna boom reaches diagonally upward. Compact aerospace industrial object, not humanoid or cute robot, no face, no planet. One tiny red light slit casts a restrained volumetric red fan just behind device. UI radically utilitarian: totally flat near-black rectangular message strips with crisp cut corners, light gray hairline rules and short red vertical accent at one edge, white precise sans typography. Input a very thin aerospace instrument rail with a red caret and narrow bright white send arrow, no glass shine or gradients on UI. Messages all independently floating, user aligned right assistant left; optional one short horizontal connector line between pet and input only. Overall stark white/black with small vermilion accents, precision spacecraft hardware aesthetic, minimal and premium, no green matrix or cyan holograms.
